annotations.title: Look up a repealed EU article

description: OPT-IN: read an article of a REPEALED or superseded EU act — the EU twin of lookup_article_historical. Every other EU tool resolves forward to the version in force, which is right for ordinary questions and wrong for a dispute about a transaction under the old regime. The other tools say when an act is repealed and point here; this reads it and labels it ABROGAT with the act that repealed it. Says so if the act turns out to be in force after all.
